description.zh: 错误重试间隔时间，单位s，默认值为30。
description.en: The interval of retries after a job failure. Default value: 30. Unit: seconds.

description.zh: cron类型可以选择填写自定义日历。
description.en: If you set TimeType to 1 (cron), you can specify calendar days.

description.zh:
任务接口类完整路径。

是Java任务类型时，才有该字段且必须填写完整路径。
description.en:
The full path of the job interface class.

This field is available only when you set the job type to java. In this case, you must enter a full path.

description.zh: 并行网格任务高级配置，单机单次触发执行线程数，默认值为5。
description.en: The number of threads that are triggered by a single worker at a time. Default value: 5. This parameter is an advanced configuration item of the MapReduce job.

description.zh:
任务联系人信息。
><notice>该字段已废弃></notice>
description.en: The information about the alert contact.

description.zh: 报警联系人钉钉群机器人webhook地址，参考文档：[钉钉开发文档](https://open.dingtalk.com/document/org/application-types)。
description.en: The webhook URL of the DingTalk chatbot.[](https://open.dingtalk.com/document/org/application-types)

description.zh: 用户邮箱。
description.en: The email address of the alert contact.

description.zh: 用户名。
description.en: The name of the alert contact.

description.zh: 用户手机号。
description.en: The mobile phone number of the alert contact.

description.zh:
- 任务类型选择为python/shell/k8s时，填写对应的脚本内容。
- 任务类型为golang时，content格式示例为 {"jobName":"HelloWorld"}
description.en: The script content. This parameter is required when you set the job type to python, shell, go, or k8s.

description.zh: cron类型可以选择时间偏移，单位s。
description.en: If you set TimeType to 1 (cron), you can specify a time offset. Unit: seconds.

description.zh: 任务描述。
description.en: The job description.

description.zh: 并行网格任务高级配置，子任务分发线程数，默认值为5。
description.en: The number of task distribution threads. Default value: 5. This parameter is an advanced configuration item of the MapReduce job.

description.zh:
任务执行模式，目前支持以下几种任务执行模式：

- **单机运行**：standalone
- **广播运行**：broadcatst
- **可视化MapReduce**：parallel
- **MapReduce**：batch
- **分片运行**：shard
description.en:
The execution mode of the job. Valid values:

- **Stand-alone operation**: standalone

- **Broadcast run**: broadcatst

- **Visual MapReduce**: parallel

- **MapReduce**: batch

- **Shard run**: shard

description.zh:
失败报警开关。取值如下：

- **true**：开启失败报警开关。
- **false**：关闭失败报警开关。
description.en:
Specifies whether to turn on Failure alarm. If the switch is turned on, an alert will be generated upon a failure. Valid values:

- **true**

- **false**

description.zh: 连续失败报警次数
description.en: The number of consecutive failures. An alert will be received if the number of consecutive failures reaches the value of this parameter.

description.zh: 应用ID，在控制台的应用管理页面中获取。
description.en: The application ID. You can obtain the application ID on the Application Management page in the SchedulerX console.

description.zh: 任务ID，在控制台的任务管理页面中获取。
description.en: The job ID. You can obtain the job ID on the Task Management page in the SchedulerX console.

description.zh: 错误最大重试次数，根据业务需求填写。
description.en: The maximum number of retries after a job failure. This parameter is specified based on your business requirements.

description.zh: 最大同时运行实例数量，默认值为1，即上次触发没有运行结束，不会进行下次触发即使到了运行时刻。
description.en: The maximum number of concurrent instances. Default value: 1. The default value indicates that only one instance is allowed to run at a time. When an instance is running, another instance is not triggered even if the scheduled time for running the instance is reached.

description.zh:
是否开启无可用机器告警。
- **true**：开启无可用机器告警开关。
- **false**：关闭无可用机器告警开关。
description.en:
Specifies whether to turn on No machine alarm available. If the switch is turned on, an alert will be generated when no machine is available for running the job. Valid values:

- **true**

- **false**

description.zh: 任务名。
description.en: The job name.

description.zh: 命名空间ID，在控制台的命名空间页面中获取。
description.en: The namespace ID. You can obtain the namespace ID on the Namespace page in the SchedulerX console.

description.zh: 特殊第三方才需要填写。
description.en: The namespace source. This parameter is required only for a special third party.

description.zh: 并行网格任务高级配置，单次拉取子任务数，默认值为100。
description.en: The number of tasks that can be pulled at a time. Default value: 100. This parameter is an advanced configuration item of the MapReduce job.

description.zh: 用户自定义参数，运行时可以获取。
description.en: The user-defined parameters that you can obtain when the job is running.

Task Priority. Valid values:

- **1**: Low

- **5**: Medium

- **10**: High

- **15**: Very High

description.zh: 并行网格任务高级配置，子任务队列缓存上限，默认值为10000。
description.en: The maximum number of tasks that can be queued. Default value: 10000. This parameter is an advanced configuration item of the MapReduce job.

description.zh: 地域ID。
description.en: The region ID.

description.zh: 报警发送形式，目前只支持sms。
description.en: The method that is used to send alerts. Only Short Message Service (SMS) is supported.

description.zh: 成功通知开关
description.en: Specifies whether to turn on Successful notice. If the switch is turned on, a notice will be sent when a job succeeds.

description.zh: 并行网格任务高级配置，子任务失败重试间隔。
description.en: The interval of retries after a task failure. This parameter is an advanced configuration item of the MapReduce job.

description.zh: 并行网格任务高级配置，推模型或者拉模型
description.en: The job mode. Valid values: push and pull. This parameter is an advanced configuration item of the MapReduce job.

description.zh: 并行网格任务高级配置，子任务失败重试次数。
description.en: The number of retries after a task failure. This parameter is an advanced configuration item of the MapReduce job.

description.zh: k8s任务类型自定义任务模版
description.en: Custom task template for the k8s task type.

description.zh:
时间表达式，根据选择的时间类型设置时间表达式。

- **cron**：填写标准的cron表达式，支持在线验证。
- **api**：无时间表达式。
- **fixed_rate**：填写具体固定频率值，单位s。如30表示每隔30s触发一次。
- **second_delay**：填写固定延迟多少秒执行一次（1s~60s可选）。
description.en:
The time expression. Specify the time expression based on the value of TimeType:

- If you set TimeType to **1** (cron), specify this parameter to a standard CRON expression.

- If you set TimeType to **100** (api), no time expression is required.

- If you set TimeType to **3** (fixed\_rate), specify this parameter to a fixed frequency in seconds. For example, if you set this parameter to 30, the system triggers a job every 30 seconds.

- If you set TimeType to **4** (second\_delay), specify this parameter to a fixed delay after which the job is triggered. Valid values: 1 to 60. Unit: seconds.

description.zh:
时间配置类型，目前支持以下几种配置类型：

- **cron**：1
- **fix_rate**：3
- **second_delay**：4
- **one_time** ：5
- **api**：100
description.en:
The time type. Valid values:

- **1**: cron

- **3**: fix\_rate

- **4**: second\_delay

- **100**: api

description.zh: 超时阈值，单位s。
description.en: The timeout threshold. Unit: seconds.

description.zh:
超时报警开关。取值如下：

- **true**：开启超时报警开关。
- **false**：关闭超时报警开关。
description.en:
Specifies whether to turn on Timeout alarm. If the switch is turned on, an alert will be generated upon a timeout. Valid values:

- **true**

- **false**

description.zh:
超时终止本次触发开关。取值如下：

- **true**：开启超时终止开关。
- **false**：关闭超时终止开关。
description.en:
Specifies whether to turn on Timeout termination. If the switch is turned on, the job will be terminated upon a timeout. Valid values:

- **true**

- **false**
